response.justification: While Bogdan easily meets the minimum requirement of 15 years of software engineering experience and brings a valuable entrepreneurial background, he falls short of the expectations for a Director-level Principal Engineer in AI Strategy. His AI experience appears very recent and limited to tooling, lacking the deep, recognized industry expertise and strategic enterprise advisory skills required to drive AI product differentiation at this level.
strengths: Over 18 years of diverse software engineering experience across multiple tech stacks and platforms.
Entrepreneurial background as the founder of an open-source Geo-Data platform.
Demonstrated ability to share knowledge and inspire others through workshops, talks, and tech community engagement.
concerns: Lacks the Director-level strategic leadership and enterprise advisory experience required for the role.
AI experience is very recent and does not demonstrate recognized, deep industry expertise.
Does not possess an advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in an AI-related field.
